data.exact_reserve_text: The run-off deterioration for Syndicate 1919 relating to prior year's business was GBP 12.5m. This was mainly due to the Accident & Health class which saw an increase in exposure in the 2013 underwriting year, with relatively poor associated attritional loss experience.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase in exposure in the 2013 underwriting year in Accident & Health, with relatively poor associated attritional loss experience leading to prior year runoff deterioration.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a prior-year run-off deterioration of GBP 12.5m (approximately 2.84% of opening gross claims outstanding), mainly driven by adverse development in the Accident & Health class where increased 2013 exposure and poor attritional claims experience led to strengthening of reserves.
